Outcome_variable.evidence_source: [/page/5/Text/6] After testing for longitudinal measurement equivalence, point-biserial correlations were computed to examine the association between each possible CES-D subscale and MDD.

lag.evidence_source: [/page/4/Text/6] The one-factor model provided a good fit to the data for Wave 1 but a poor fit to the data for Waves 3, 5, and 7. [/page/5/Text/6] We examined the association between the CES-D at Wave 1 and prior month MDD at Wave 1, the CES-D at Wave 3 and prior year MDD at Wave 4, the CES-D at Wave 5 and prior year MDD at Wave 6, and the CES-D at Wave 7 and prior year MDD at Wave 8.
lag.warning: CES-D waves are 1, 3, 5, 7 (2-year lag). MDD waves are 1, 4, 6, 8 (lags of 3, 2, 2 years). The modal/typical lag is 2 years.
